name: Nintendo 64
description: Nintendo's 1996 console, built with Silicon Graphics, which brought 3D worlds to the living room with Super Mario 64 and The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time. It stuck with cartridges while rivals used CDs, and its controller introduced an analog stick that set a template for 3D games.

specs.memory: 4 MB RDRAM (8 MB with Expansion Pak)

curiosities: Its RAM is unified, shared by the CPU and graphics.
Consoles shipped with a Jumper Pak filling the memory slot that the Expansion Pak later used.
The Rumble Pak, introduced with Star Fox 64, made force feedback common on controllers.
The 64DD disk drive was released only in Japan and sold poorly.
GoldenEye 007 was made at Rare by a team most of whom had never made a game before.
